description: List all search indices in the Algolia application.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'items' list of index metadata and 'nbPages'.

description: Get the search settings for an index.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the index settings (searchableAttributes, attributesForFaceting, hitsPerPage, ranking); on failure (index not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search an index with an optional query string, filters, and paging.

index.description: The name of the index to query.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring query matched across string fields.

filters.description: Optional attr:value equality filter, optionally AND-joined.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a search response (hits, nbHits, page, nbPages, hitsPerPage, query, params); on failure (index not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single object from an index by its objectID.

object_id.description: The objectID of the record to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the object record; on failure (index or object not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a new object to an index (creating the index if it does not exist).

index.description: The name of the index to add to.

body.description: The object to store; if it omits objectID a new one is generated.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with objectID, createdAt, and taskID.

description: Update (merge) an object in an index by its objectID, creating it if absent.

object_id.description: The objectID of the record to update.

body.description: The fields to merge into the object.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with objectID, updatedAt, and taskID; on failure (index not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete an object from an index by its objectID.

object_id.description: The objectID of the record to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with objectID, deletedAt, and taskID; on failure (index or object not found), output contains an error message.
